Dallas Central Appraisal District · Data export, BPP detail & certified rolls · Tax years 2026–2027

Dallas Property Data Profile

Everything Dallas CAD makes available to us in bulk, from three sources: the DCAD data export (14 related tables, published as the July 23 certified export and as current 2026 and 2027 exports), the business personal property detail file, and the certified appraisal rolls. For each file you get its columns, data types, completeness and value distributions. Column descriptions come from DCAD's TABLES AND FIELD NAMES.xlsx and data dictionary where it has them.
